title: Was Randy shown alien technology as a reverse-engineering litmus test
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Was Randy shown alien technology as a reverse-engineering litmus test, about an unknown time at US military base, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was Randy shown this technology as a weapons expert to see if he could figure it out reverse engineer it on the spot as a litmus test to see how an exposed adversary might react

plain: Randy Anderson is a man who says he saw alien technology at a US military base, and a podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviewed him. Michels wonders aloud whether Randy, as a weapons expert, was shown the technology on purpose, as a test to see if he could figure out how it worked on the spot. In that view, his reaction would show officials how a foreign enemy might react if it got its hands on the same thing.
